ApprovalProcess.description: Audit-only approval cycle invoked programmatically when a JIRA ticket transitions to Done and the warehouse replenishment workflow auto-activates the Order. No field updates fire (Order is already Activated by the time this runs); the sole purpose is to create a Process Instance Step record showing "Inventory confirmed in stock via JIRA TS-X" in the Order's Approval History — symmetric to the VF page Mark In Stock path.
ApprovalProcess.label: Inventory Audit Approval
